Bug_Details: This checker errors on calls to java.time methods using values that are guaranteed to throw a DateTimeException.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by attempting to parse an invalid date string '2023-02-30' using LocalDate.parse(). This date does not exist, and thus a DateTimeException is thrown.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the JavaTimeBugDemo class, which attempts to parse an invalid date string '2023-02-30'. This results in a DateTimeException being thrown, causing the test to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test passed without any failures, which means the bug was not triggered as expected.
